d: Republican US Senate candidate Mike Rogers casts his ballot in White Lake, Michigan, on Election Day 2026, expressing confidence in his campaign as he faces Democrat Abdul El-Sayed in a closely watched Senate race. Speaking to reporters, Rogers claims his campaign has built strong support across Michigan and says Republican voters are energised to prevent a Democratic victory. Rogers takes aim at El-Sayed's progressive politics, describing him as a candidate backed by the Democratic Socialists of America. With control of the US Senate at stake, Michigan's contest has become a major…
